valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.pe_withheld_reason: Withheld: the period FY2019 reports no positive net profit, so a P/E is not defined. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.pb_withheld_reason: Withheld: total equity is not on file for FY2019, so a P/B cannot be built. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.earnings_yield_withheld_reason: Withheld: the earnings behind the earnings yield are not verified: the period FY2019 reports no positive net profit, so a P/E is not defined. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.ev_ebit_withheld_reason: Withheld: EBIT and net debt are not both on file for FY2019, so EV/EBIT cannot be built. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.peg_withheld_reason: Withheld: the P/E a PEG divides is itself withheld, so there is no P/E to divide by the growth rate. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.psFormula: current price / revenue per share, where revenue per share = revenue / shares outstanding
valuation.psRevenueRow: the income statement's revenue line for FY2019, read from the row labelled 'Revenue'
valuation.psSharesSource: the same 2.19956e+08 shares behind the market capitalisation (NGX 'List of Equities as of 2026-04-09' (doclib.ngxgroup.com), shares outstanding; price 20.0 EGP)
valuation.note: loss-making in the latest period, so P/E is not meaningful
valuation.ps_withheld_reason: Withheld: the share count behind this P/S (219,956,000) is Aluminium Extrusion Industries Plc's, an NGX count, divided into Alexandria Cement Co.'s EGX FY2019 revenue of 2,195,690,000 at an EGX price of 22.5. The share count belongs to another issuer on another exchange, so the multiple is cross-issuer and is not a valuation of Alexandria Cement. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
